item.title: HSE board to appear before cttee over O'Connor sacking
item.description: The board of the HSE is to appear before the Oireachtas health committee next week to answer questions about its controversial sacking of former chief executive Anne O'Connor.

item.title: 'Danger here' as HSE crisis deepens for board and Govt
item.description: With no end to the controversy around Anne O'Connor's sacking as HSE chief in sight, it is very much a case of "danger here" for the HSE board, the Minister for Health and the Government, writes Barry Lenihan.

item.title: Rare disease patients cite staffing for drug access delay
item.description: Patients with Spinal Muscular Atrophy say they are unable to access an approved drug for the rare condition due to staffing shortages at the main treatment centre.

item.title: Eight months: What we know about the sacking of a HSE CEO
item.description: What is known about how Anne O'Connor went from being the best candidate for one of the most difficult jobs in the public service, to being fired less than eight months later?

item.title: New annual record set for hospital overcrowding - INMO
item.description: A new annual record has been for hospital overcrowding as 123,262 patients were treated on trolleys and in other inappropriate spaces this year, according to INMO figures.
